dogecoin.text: @AccountingAsArt If he buys and holds, make sure that he doesn't do any conversions. If he buys Bitcoin, he buys Bitcoin, and that's fine. But the second he converts his Bitcoin to Dogecoin, you've got problems up in these parts.

@KJSAcct @rattlerfg @IraGilligan I'm warmed up to crypto in general a lot more over the course of the last 14 months because I've had no choice but to educate myself on the topic. I'll never understand Dogecoin. But so many of the rest of them do seem to have utility purposes.
